calls.title: 30 min with Scott (Mike Hartington )
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the technical and product strategies led by Mike Hartington, who emphasized user feedback and his dual role in engineering and Developer Relations. He shared insights on a major platform rebuild for AI-readiness, which included migrating content to Next.js for improved SEO and accessibility. Scott Bailey highlighted the importance of understanding feature flagging for enterprises, particularly alternatives to LaunchDarkly. The conversation also touched on the growing reliance on AI tools in workflow, with Mike sharing his pragmatic embrace of these tools for efficiency. Furthermore, short-form video content was discussed as a dominant engagement strategy, while Mike emphasized transparency in managing community feedback to rebuild trust. The need for collaboration between DevRel and product marketing was underscored, along with a reminder to continually enhance knowledge in relevant technical areas.
calls.keywords: feature flagging, DevRel, product marketing, AI-assisted coding, documentation migration, developer content consumption
calls.action_items:
**Mike Hartington**
Research complex use cases of feature flagging, data warehouses, and experimentation in enterprise contexts as preparation for the role (26:44)

**Scott Bailey**
Provide answers to any follow-up questions Mike sends by email post-meeting (29:26)
